<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Drystone — AWS Security Findings Report</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       TOKENS
    ============================================================ */
    :root {
      /* Brand */
      --navy-900: #0d0f30;
      --navy-800: #13163d;
      --navy-700: #1a1f52;
      --navy-600: #252a66;
      --navy-400: #4a5299;
      --navy-200: #9199cc;
      --navy-100: #c8ccee;
      --navy-50:  #eeeff8;

      /* Accent — single hue, oklch-derived */
      --accent:       oklch(58% 0.17 250);
      --accent-light: oklch(72% 0.13 250);
      --accent-dim:   oklch(92% 0.05 250);

      /* Semantic severity */
      --sev-critical:     #c0292b;
      --sev-critical-bg:  #fdf2f2;
      --sev-critical-br:  #f5c6c6;
      --sev-high:         #c2540a;
      --sev-high-bg:      #fef6ee;
      --sev-high-br:      #fad8b8;
      --sev-medium:       #1d6fa4;
      --sev-medium-bg:    #eff6fd;
      --sev-medium-br:    #b8d9f3;
      --sev-low:          #1a7a4a;
      --sev-low-bg:       #f0faf5;
      --sev-low-br:       #b0dfc8;

      /* Surfaces */
      --bg:           #f2f4f8;
      --surface:      #ffffff;
      --surface-alt:  #f8f9fc;
      --border:       #dde2ec;
      --border-soft:  #edf0f5;

      /* Text */
      --text-1: #111827;
      --text-2: #374151;
      --text-3: #6b7280;
      --text-4: #9ca3af;

      /* Type */
      --font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

      /* Spacing */
      --r-sm: 6px;
      --r-md: 10px;
      --r-lg: 14px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PRINT SETUP
    ============================================================ */
    @page {
      size: A4 portrait;
      margin: 0 0 14mm 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      @bottom-left {
        content: "Drystone Security Report · Confidential";
        font-family: var(--font-sans);
        font-size: 7.5px;
        color: #9ca3af;
        margin-left: 16mm;
      }
      @bottom-right {
        content: "Page " counter(page) " of " counter(pages);
        font-family: var(--font-sans);
        font-size: 7.5px;
        color: #9ca3af;
        margin-right: 16mm;
      }
    }

    @page :first {
      margin: 0;
      @bottom-left { content: ""; }
      @bottom-right { content: ""; }
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    /* ============================================================
       BASE
    ============================================================ */
    html { background: var(--bg); }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      color: var(--text-1);
      background: transparent;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       COVER PAGE
    ============================================================ */
    .cover {
      min-height: 297mm;
      background: linear-gradient(175deg, #17143d 0%, #0d0f30 100%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      page-break-after: always;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* Geometric accents */
    .cover::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -80px; right: -80px;
      width: 420px; height: 420px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 60px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.025);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .cover::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -60px; left: -60px;
      width: 300px; height: 300px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 40px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .cover-stripe {
      height: 4px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c084fc 0%, #e879a0 45%, #fb923c 80%, #f97316 100%);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .cover-body {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0 18mm;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .cover-wordmark {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }

    .cover-ascii-logo {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 7.2px;
      line-height: 1.15;
      white-space: pre;
      color: #b8c6ff;
      border: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }

    .cover-wordmark-version {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      color: var(--navy-200);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      margin-top: 6px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .cover-tagline {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--accent-light);
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .cover-title {
      font-size: 38px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      max-width: 560px;
    }

    .cover-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--navy-200);
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }

    .cover-meta-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-radius: var(--r-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      max-width: 460px;
    }

    .cover-meta-item {
      padding: 14px 18px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }

    .cover-meta-item:nth-child(even) { border-right: none; }
    .cover-meta-item:nth-last-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: none; }

    .cover-meta-label {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--navy-200);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .cover-meta-value {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .cover-footer {
      padding: 16px 18mm;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .cover-footer-label {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      color: var(--navy-400);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    }

    .cover-confidential {
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--navy-400);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       REPORT CONTENT WRAPPER
    ============================================================ */
    .report-content {
      padding: 8mm 16mm 10mm 16mm;
      background: var(--bg);
    }

    .report-content p,
    .report-content li,
    .report-content td {
      text-align: justify;
      text-justify: inter-word;
    }

    .report-content pre,
    .report-content code,
    .report-content .code-block {
      text-align: left;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SECTION HEADERS (h2)
    ============================================================ */
    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 26px 0 14px 0;
      page-break-after: avoid;
    }

    .section-header-num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text-1);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.9px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .section-rule {
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
    }

    h3 {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-1);
      margin: 14px 0 8px 0;
    }

    h4 {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-2);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin: 10px 0 6px 0;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CARD
    ============================================================ */
    .card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--r-lg);
      padding: 14px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       DOCUMENT CONTROL / SCOPE
    ============================================================ */
    .meta-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .meta-table tr { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
    .meta-table tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    .meta-table td {
      padding: 7px 6px;
      vertical-align: top;
      text-align: left !important;
    }

    .meta-table td:first-child {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--text-3);
      width: 140px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .meta-table td:last-child {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-1);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SEVERITY PILLS
    ============================================================ */
    .pill {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      line-height: 1.4;
      white-space: nowrap;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
    }

    .pill-critical { color: var(--sev-critical); background: var(--sev-critical-bg); border-color: var(--sev-critical-br); }
    .pill-high     { color: var(--sev-high);     background: var(--sev-high-bg);     border-color: var(--sev-high-br); }
    .pill-medium   { color: var(--sev-medium);   background: var(--sev-medium-bg);   border-color: var(--sev-medium-br); }
    .pill-low      { color: var(--sev-low);      background: var(--sev-low-bg);      border-color: var(--sev-low-br); }

    /* ============================================================
       TABLES
    ============================================================ */
    .data-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: separate;
      border-spacing: 0;
      font-size: 10px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      margin: 10px 0;
    }

    .data-table thead tr { background: var(--navy-800); }

    .data-table th {
      padding: 10px 10px;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--navy-100);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-600);
    }

    .data-table th.center,
    .data-table td.center { text-align: center !important; }

    .data-table tbody tr { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
    .data-table tbody tr:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .data-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: var(--surface-alt); }

    .data-table td {
      padding: 9px 10px;
      vertical-align: middle;
      color: var(--text-2);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
    }

    .data-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

    .data-table .totals-row td {
      background: #eef0fa;
      border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-1);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       SEVERITY BAR
    ============================================================ */
    .sev-bar-wrap {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .sev-bar {
      flex: 1;
      height: 7px;
      background: var(--border-soft);
      border-radius: 99px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .sev-bar-fill { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; }
    .sev-bar-fill.critical { background: var(--sev-critical); }
    .sev-bar-fill.high     { background: var(--sev-high); }
    .sev-bar-fill.medium   { background: var(--sev-medium); }
    .sev-bar-fill.low      { background: var(--sev-low); }

    .sev-count {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-1);
      min-width: 22px;
      text-align: right;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RISK SCALE
    ============================================================ */
    .risk-scale {
      display: flex;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 8px 0 4px;
    }

    .risk-scale span { flex: 1; }
    .risk-scale .rs-ok     { background: var(--sev-low); }
    .risk-scale .rs-good   { background: #5cb85c; }
    .risk-scale .rs-medium { background: #e6a817; }
    .risk-scale .rs-high   { background: var(--sev-high); }
    .risk-scale .rs-crit   { background: var(--sev-critical); }

    .risk-scale-indicator {
      position: relative;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       FINDING CARD
    ============================================================ */
    .finding {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--r-lg);
      margin: 14px 0;
      page-break-inside: auto;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .finding + .finding { page-break-before: always; }

    .finding-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
    }

    .finding-id {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-dim);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      align-self: flex-start;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .finding-title-wrap { flex: 1; }

    .finding-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-1);
      margin: 0 0 6px 0;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .finding-meta {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .finding-body { padding: 14px 16px; }

    .finding-section {
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border);
    }

    .finding-section:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
      padding-bottom: 0;
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .finding-description-box {
      background: var(--surface-alt);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-soft);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--navy-200);
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .finding-remediation-box {
      background: #f0fdf8;
      border: 1px solid #a7f3d0;
      border-left: 3px solid #059669;
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .finding-impact-box {
      background: #fff8f2;
      border: 1px solid #fad8b8;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--sev-high);
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .finding-exploitation-box {
      background: #fffbf0;
      border: 1px solid #fce9a0;
      border-left: 3px solid #d4a017;
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CODE BLOCK
    ============================================================ */
    .code-block {
      background: #13192b;
      color: #e2e8f5;
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 8.5px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      word-break: break-all;
      page-break-inside: auto;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }

    .code-block-light {
      background: var(--surface-alt);
      color: var(--text-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RESOURCE LIST
    ============================================================ */
    .resource-list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      margin: 6px 0 0 0;
      background: #13192b;
      border-left: 2px solid var(--navy-400);
      border-radius: var(--r-sm);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0;
    }

    .resource-list li {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 8.5px;
      color: #c9d5e8;
      padding: 2px 0;
      word-break: break-all;
    }

    .resource-list li::before {
      content: "–\00a0";
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .resource-list.light {
      background: var(--surface-alt);
      border-left-color: var(--border);
    }

    .resource-list.light li {
      color: var(--text-2);
    }

    /* ============================================================
       ASSESSMENT RATING
    ============================================================ */
    .rating-block,
    .assessment-rating {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--r-lg);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      margin: 10px 0;
    }

    .rating-block.excellent,
    .assessment-rating.rating-excellent { background: #f0fdf4; border-color: #86efac; }
    .rating-block.good,
    .assessment-rating.rating-good,
    .assessment-rating.rating-very-good { background: #fefce8; border-color: #fde047; }
    .rating-block.improvable,
    .assessment-rating.rating-improvable { background: #fff7ed; border-color: #fcd34d; }
    .rating-block.critical,
    .assessment-rating.rating-critical { background: var(--sev-critical-bg); border-color: var(--sev-critical-br); }

    .rating-badge {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .rating-block.excellent .rating-badge,
    .assessment-rating.rating-excellent .rating-badge { background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; }
    .rating-block.good .rating-badge,
    .assessment-rating.rating-good .rating-badge,
    .assessment-rating.rating-very-good .rating-badge { background: #fef9c3; color: #854d0e; }
    .rating-block.improvable .rating-badge,
    .assessment-rating.rating-improvable .rating-badge { background: #ffedd5; color: #9a3412; }
    .rating-block.critical .rating-badge,
    .assessment-rating.rating-critical .rating-badge { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }

    .rating-content {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .rating-label {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--text-3);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .rating-value {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .rating-block.excellent .rating-value,
    .assessment-rating.rating-excellent .rating-value { color: #15803d; }
    .rating-block.good .rating-value,
    .assessment-rating.rating-good .rating-value,
    .assessment-rating.rating-very-good .rating-value { color: #a16207; }
    .rating-block.improvable .rating-value,
    .assessment-rating.rating-improvable .rating-value { color: #c2540a; }
    .rating-block.critical .rating-value,
    .assessment-rating.rating-critical .rating-value { color: var(--sev-critical); }

    .rating-desc {
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--text-2);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PHASE DESCRIPTION
    ============================================================ */
    .phase-desc {
      background: var(--surface-alt);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--navy-200);
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      color: var(--text-2);
      font-size: 10.5px;
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PCI DSS ANNEX
    ============================================================ */
    .pci-table {
      font-size: 9px;
      table-layout: fixed;
    }

    .pci-table th {
      background: var(--navy-700);
      color: var(--navy-100);
      font-size: 8.5px;
    }

    .pci-table tr.pci-req-group td {
      background: var(--surface-alt);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-1);
      font-size: 9px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .pci-ok { color: var(--sev-low); font-weight: 700; }
    .pci-ko { color: var(--sev-critical); font-weight: 700; }

    .pci-method {
      background: var(--surface-alt);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--navy-400);
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      font-size: 9.5px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       EXECUTIVE NARRATIVE
    ============================================================ */
    .executive-narrative p {
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--text-2);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .executive-narrative p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    /* ============================================================
       TIMELINE
    ============================================================ */
    .timeline {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      position: relative;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .timeline::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 18px; top: 10px; bottom: 10px;
      width: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
    }

    .timeline-item {
      position: relative;
      padding: 0 0 14px 40px;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
    }

    .timeline-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }

    .timeline-dot {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px; top: 3px;
      width: 13px; height: 13px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }

    .timeline-dot.dot-critical { border-color: var(--sev-critical); background: var(--sev-critical-bg); }
    .timeline-dot.dot-high     { border-color: var(--sev-high);     background: var(--sev-high-bg); }
    .timeline-dot.dot-medium   { border-color: var(--sev-medium);   background: var(--sev-medium-bg); }
    .timeline-dot.dot-low      { border-color: var(--sev-low);      background: var(--sev-low-bg); }

    .timeline-label {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
      color: var(--text-3);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .timeline-text {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      color: var(--text-2);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PAGE BREAK & MISC
    ============================================================ */
    .page-break { page-break-before: always; }
    .phase-section { page-break-before: always; }
    .phase-section:first-of-type { page-break-before: auto; }

    h2 + .card,
    h2 + .phase-desc { page-break-before: avoid; }

    .analogy {
      margin: 10px 0 0;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--border);
      background: #f9fafc;
      color: var(--text-3);
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 9.5px;
      border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
    }

    /* Index */
    .index-list { padding-left: 18px; }
    .index-list > li { margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .index-sublist { padding-left: 16px; margin-top: 4px; }
    .index-sublist li { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-2); margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .index-code { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 600; }

    /* Conditions */
    .conditions-list { list-style: disc; padding-left: 20px; margin: 6px 0; }
    .conditions-list li { margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--text-2); }

    /* Top recommendations in executive summary */
    .top-recommendations-list {
      margin: 0;
      padding-left: 20px;
    }

    .top-recommendations-list li {
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .severity-pill {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 9px;
      margin-right: 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.2px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      white-space: nowrap;
      vertical-align: baseline;
    }

    .severity-critical { color: var(--sev-critical); background: var(--sev-critical-bg); border-color: var(--sev-critical-br); }
    .severity-high     { color: var(--sev-high);     background: var(--sev-high-bg);     border-color: var(--sev-high-br); }
    .severity-medium   { color: var(--sev-medium);   background: var(--sev-medium-bg);   border-color: var(--sev-medium-br); }
    .severity-low      { color: var(--sev-low);      background: var(--sev-low-bg);      border-color: var(--sev-low-br); }

    /* Section divider label */
    .section-divider {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
      margin: 26px 0 14px;
      page-break-after: avoid;
    }

    .section-divider-label {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--text-4);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .section-divider hr {
      flex: 1;
      border: none;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    /* Stat pill row */
    .stat-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin: 8px 0;
    }

    .stat-pill {
      background: var(--surface-alt);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--r-md);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      min-width: 80px;
    }

    .stat-pill-label {
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--text-3);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .stat-pill-value {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .stat-pill-value.critical { color: var(--sev-critical); }
    .stat-pill-value.high     { color: var(--sev-high); }
    .stat-pill-value.medium   { color: var(--sev-medium); }
    .stat-pill-value.low      { color: var(--sev-low); }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

============================================================ -->
